title: hotfix: tighten SLO enforcement + regional failover backoff to prevent cascading load-shedding
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Hotfix: Correct SLO evaluation window and add hysteresis + exponential backoff for regional failover to prevent cascading load-shedding. No customer-facing API changes.
description:
Context: During a recent partial-region capacity event we observed cascading load-shedding and repeated regional failovers that pushed traffic between regions and caused client-visible 503s. Root cause: the SLO enforcer used a coarse request-count-based threshold with a short evaluation window and no hysteresis, combined with a tight regional-failover policy. This caused transient latency spikes to trip circuit breakers too aggressively.

This PR implements a hotfix to reduce cascading failures: 
- switch SLO evaluation to a sliding-time-window latency-weighted sampler (reduces sensitivity to short blips)
- add hysteresis to the local circuit breaker (require sustained exceedance before open)
- introduce exponential backoff for regional failover attempts and require a successful healthy-check window before rejoining a drained region
- add metrics for cb_state_transitions, slo_evaluator_windowed_p50/p95, regional_failover_backoff_seconds to aid debugging
- update canary test and add unit/integration tests covering sustained vs transient load scenarios

Checklist: 
- [x] implement windowed SLO evaluator and hysteresis
- [x] exponential backoff for failover + minimum healthy window
- [x] add metrics and traces for state transitions
- [x] unit and integration tests updated/added
- [x] docs: incident response note + rollout guidance
- [x] staged rollout: feature-flagged default-on for main clusters

Risk and rollout: This is a behavioral change to SLO enforcement and failover heuristics but guarded behind the existing feature flag slo_enforcer_v2 with default enabled in-hosted clusters after verification. We will deploy progressively to a small set of canary clusters for 24h before global rollout.

Files changed (high level) listed below. See commits for details.

Related: ENG-4921 (investigate repeated regional failovers), SRE-118 (post-incident remediation), SUP-2109 (customer impact trace).
